units.source_text: 美貌少年阿多尼斯，为了安慰为自己的死而悲伤的恋人维纳斯，转世为侧金盏花。

en.t: The beautiful youth Adonis was reborn as a marigold to comfort his lover Venus, who grieved over his death.

units.source_text: 阿波罗悲叹美貌的年轻人雅辛托斯的死，把情人的倩影，变成了风信子。

en.t: Apollo mourned the death of the beautiful young Hyacinthus and transformed his lover's lovely image into a hyacinth.
